answer.evidence: The sign is a vertical panel drawn face-on. The brown board (rows 7-30) has a dark 1-2 row rim at rows 7-8 and white lettering over the whole face. It has no edge line, eave shadow or ellipse that would show a horizontal surface. The gray-blue header (rows 1-5, width 16 at rows 2-4) is a flat front-facing strip with a white highlight. It is not an ellipse and has no front-edge line. The base at rows 28-30 is also drawn as a vertical face. No contents, roof or awning are visible. The width profile is a constant 14 from row 5 to row 30, so no top plane widens or narrows.

styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a vertical brown standing sign with a rounded cap and white 카/페 lettering on a reddish-brown panel. Measured facts: 10 visible tones per tile, versus 6 (bus-shelter), 12 (kiosk) and 20 (vending). Near-flat coverage is 0%, and 0% of its dark edge pixels are neutral, so the outline is tinted dark brown/red-brown rather than black. There are no flat fills. The brown body shows about 4 steps (highlight on the left edge, mid, dark, deep) plus the cap and base. That is slightly less than the vending and kiosk references, which show 5-6 steps with more grain and detail. Material grain on the panel is modest, and the lettering block is simple. It is above the bus-shelter and close to the kiosk, so it would sit acceptably next to the references without looking like a sticker.

styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a tall brown standing sign with a rounded top cap and two stacked white Korean glyph blocks (카 / 페) on a reddish-brown body. It carries 10 visible tones per 16x16 tile, 0% near-flat coverage and 0% neutral dark edge pixels, so the outline is tinted dark brown rather than black. That sits above bus-shelter-a (6) and just under kiosk-a (12). It is well below vending-a (20), which has far more detail. The body shading looks like about 4 steps: a left highlight strip, a mid tone, a dark right side and a cap highlight. The references show 5-6 steps, with panels, trim and small details such as the vending machine's buttons and the kiosk's awning stripes. The candidate's body is a mostly smooth vertical gradient with little grain, panel seam or surface wear. The lettering gives some variation, but the large brown areas are clean and plain. It is a competent piece but a bit simpler than the better references, and it is not clearly equal to them.

styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a vertical brown signboard with a rounded cap and the Korean text 카페 in light letters. It reads as a clean prop at the same scale as the references. Near-flat coverage is 0%, so there are no large flat fills, and the dark edge pixels are 0% neutral, so the outline is tinted (dark brown beside the brown body) and not a black sticker line. That makes it slightly lower in texture and density than the best references. It is still on par with the bus shelter and acceptable next to the kiosk, so it passes.
